educational_qualifications: Primary Teacher (PRT): 12th with 45% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT): Bachelor Degree in Related Subject and B.Ed
Post Graduate Teacher (PGT): Master Degree in Related Subject
age_limits: 18-38 years for PRT, 18-42 years for TGT, 18-40 years for PGT
medical_physical_fitness: As per the norms of the Board of School Education Haryana
quotas_and_gender_rules: Reservation as per Haryana Government Rules
